description: Settings for the virus and file-type check applied to uploaded files.

fields.label: ClamAV Host
fields.description: The address of the virus scanner. Blank uses the built-in service.

fields.label: ClamAV Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: The time spent waiting for a scan before the scanner is treated as unreachable. The person uploading waits it out, so a long timeout is felt as a slow form. Blank uses 30.

fields.label: If Scanner Unavailable
fields.description: Decides what happens when the virus scanner cannot be reached. Block refuses the upload; Allow accepts it on the file-type check alone. Blank refuses.

fields.label: Active Channels
fields.description: Screening runs only for the channels listed here. Empty means nothing is screened.

fields.label: Blocking Verdicts
fields.description: The verdicts that refuse an upload. A verdict left out is still recorded in the scan log but no longer stops the file; empty means all of them refuse.

fields.label: Scan Log Retention (days)
fields.description: The age at which a scan verdict is deleted. Blank uses 90.

name: CRM File Screening Settings
